description: Report the native (CELO) and ERC-20 stablecoin balances of a buy account — the same data as the `buy whoami` CLI command. Read-only: no keychain access, no signing. Use this before buy_send or buy_curl to confirm the wallet is funded.

account.description: Account name. Defaults to the configured default account.

sandbox.description: If true, report balances on celo-sepolia. Otherwise uses the account network.

name: buy_balance
title: Check wallet balances
